title: phyteuma michelii subsp. scorzonerifolium
intro: Phyteuma michelii subsp. scorzonerifolium, commonly known as Alpine Cottongrass, is a species of flowering plant in the bellflower family (Campanulaceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Phyteuma michelii subsp. scorzonerifolium include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
